import Mathlib.RepresentationTheory.Homological.GroupCohomology.LowDegree
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Alternating.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases

/-!
# Alternation of integral group two-cocycles

For an abelian group with trivial integral coefficients, antisymmetrizing a
group two-cocycle gives an alternating bilinear form. Coboundaries have zero
alternation, so this construction descends to Mathlib's group cohomology.
Bijectivity for a lattice is a separate assertion.

Reference: Mumford, *Abelian Varieties*, Chapter I, pp. 16-17.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {U : Type} [AddCommGroup U]

/-- The source's antisymmetrization of a group two-cocycle. -/
def groupTwoCocycleAlternation
    (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ))
    (u v : U) : ℤ :=
  F (Multiplicative.ofAdd u, Multiplicative.ofAdd v) -
    F (Multiplicative.ofAdd v, Multiplicative.ofAdd u)

@[simp]
theorem groupTwoCocycleAlternation_self
    (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ))
    (u : U) : groupTwoCocycleAlternation F u u = 0 := by
  simp [groupTwoCocycleAlternation]

theorem groupTwoCocycleAlternation_swap
    (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ))
    (u v : U) : groupTwoCocycleAlternation F v u =
      -groupTwoCocycleAlternation F u v := by
  simp [groupTwoCocycleAlternation, neg_sub]

/-- Three substitutions in the cocycle identity give additivity. -/
theorem groupTwoCocycleAlternation_add_right
    (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ))
    (u v w : U) : groupTwoCocycleAlternation F u (v + w) =
      groupTwoCocycleAlternation F u v + groupTwoCocycleAlternation F u w := by
  have h₁ := (groupCohomology.mem_cocycles₂_iff F).mp F.property
    (Multiplicative.ofAdd v) (Multiplicative.ofAdd w) (Multiplicative.ofAdd u)
  have h₂ := (groupCohomology.mem_cocycles₂_iff F).mp F.property
    (Multiplicative.ofAdd u) (Multiplicative.ofAdd v) (Multiplicative.ofAdd w)
  have h₃ := (groupCohomology.mem_cocycles₂_iff F).mp F.property
    (Multiplicative.ofAdd v) (Multiplicative.ofAdd u) (Multiplicative.ofAdd w)
  simp only [Representation.isTrivial_apply, ← ofAdd_add] at h₁ h₂ h₃
  rw [add_comm v u] at h₃
  rw [add_comm w u] at h₁
  unfold groupTwoCocycleAlternation
  omega

theorem groupTwoCocycleAlternation_add_left
    (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ))
    (u v w : U) : groupTwoCocycleAlternation F (u + v) w =
      groupTwoCocycleAlternation F u w + groupTwoCocycleAlternation F v w := by
  rw [groupTwoCocycleAlternation_swap, groupTwoCocycleAlternation_add_right,
    neg_add, ← groupTwoCocycleAlternation_swap, ← groupTwoCocycleAlternation_swap]

@[simp]
theorem groupTwoCocycleAlternation_zero_right
    (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ))
    (u : U) : groupTwoCocycleAlternation F u 0 = 0 := by
  have h := groupTwoCocycleAlternation_add_right F u 0 0
  simpa using h

@[simp]
theorem groupTwoCocycleAlternation_zero_left
    (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ))
    (u : U) : groupTwoCocycleAlternation F 0 u = 0 := by
  rw [groupTwoCocycleAlternation_swap, groupTwoCocycleAlternation_zero_right, neg_zero]

private def groupTwoCocycleAlternationHom
    (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ)) :
    U →+ U →+ ℤ where
  toFun u :=
    { toFun := groupTwoCocycleAlternation F u
      map_zero' := groupTwoCocycleAlternation_zero_right F u
      map_add' := groupTwoCocycleAlternation_add_right F u }
  map_zero' := by ext v; exact groupTwoCocycleAlternation_zero_left F v
  map_add' u v := by ext w; exact groupTwoCocycleAlternation_add_left F u v w

/-- Alternation as an integral alternating form in two variables. -/
def groupTwoCocycleAlternatingMap
    (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ)) :
    AlternatingMap ℤ U ℤ (Fin 2) where
  toFun v := groupTwoCocycleAlternation F (v 0) (v 1)
  map_update_add' v i x y := by
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using groupTwoCocycleAlternation_add_left F x y (v 1)
    · simpa using groupTwoCocycleAlternation_add_right F (v 0) x y
  map_update_smul' v i c x := by
    fin_cases i
    · have h := congrArg (fun f : U →+ ℤ => f (v 1))
        ((groupTwoCocycleAlternationHom F).map_zsmul c x)
      change groupTwoCocycleAlternation F (c • x) (v 1) =
        c • groupTwoCocycleAlternation F x (v 1) at h
      simpa using h
    · have h := ((groupTwoCocycleAlternationHom F) (v 0)).map_zsmul c x
      change groupTwoCocycleAlternation F (v 0) (c • x) =
        c • groupTwoCocycleAlternation F (v 0) x at h
      simpa using h
  map_eq_zero_of_eq' v i j h hij := by
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
    · change groupTwoCocycleAlternation F (v 0) (v 1) = 0
      change v 0 = v 1 at h
      rw [h, groupTwoCocycleAlternation_self]
    · change groupTwoCocycleAlternation F (v 0) (v 1) = 0
      change v 1 = v 0 at h
      rw [h, groupTwoCocycleAlternation_self]
    · exact (hij rfl).elim

@[simp]
theorem groupTwoCocycleAlternatingMap_apply
    (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ))
    (v : Fin 2 → U) :
    groupTwoCocycleAlternatingMap F v = groupTwoCocycleAlternation F (v 0) (v 1) := rfl

/-- Antisymmetrization is linear in the group cocycle. -/
def groupTwoCocyclesAlternation :
    groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ]
      AlternatingMap ℤ U ℤ (Fin 2) where
  toFun := groupTwoCocycleAlternatingMap
  map_add' F G := by
    ext v
    change (F (Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 0), Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 1)) +
      G (Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 0), Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 1))) -
        (F (Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 1), Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 0)) +
          G (Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 1), Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 0))) = _
    exact add_sub_add_comm _ _ _ _
  map_smul' c F := by
    ext v
    change c • (F _) - c • (F _) = c • (F _ - F _)
    exact (smul_sub c _ _).symm

@[simp]
theorem groupTwoCocyclesAlternation_apply
    (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ)) :
    groupTwoCocyclesAlternation F = groupTwoCocycleAlternatingMap F := rfl

/-- A group coboundary has zero alternation. -/
theorem groupTwoCocyclesAlternation_coboundary (f : Multiplicative U → ℤ) :
    groupTwoCocyclesAlternation
      ⟨groupCohomology.d₁₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) f,
        groupCohomology.d₁₂_apply_mem_cocycles₂
          (A := Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) f⟩ = 0 := by
  ext v
  change (groupCohomology.d₁₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) f)
      (Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 0), Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 1)) -
    (groupCohomology.d₁₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) f)
      (Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 1), Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 0)) = 0
  simp only [groupCohomology.d₁₂_hom_apply, Representation.isTrivial_apply]
  rw [mul_comm (Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 0)) (Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 1))]
  omega

/-- The alternation map on actual integral group cohomology. -/
def groupSecondCohomologyAlternation :
    groupCohomology.H2 (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ]
      AlternatingMap ℤ U ℤ (Fin 2) :=
  ((LinearMap.range (groupCohomology.shortComplexH2
      (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ)).moduleCatToCycles).liftQ
    groupTwoCocyclesAlternation (by
      rintro _ ⟨f, rfl⟩
      exact groupTwoCocyclesAlternation_coboundary f)).comp
    (groupCohomology.H2Iso (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ)).hom.hom

/-- The descended map has the source formula on every cocycle representative. -/
@[simp]
theorem groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_π
    (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ)) :
    groupSecondCohomologyAlternation
      (groupCohomology.H2π (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) F) =
        groupTwoCocycleAlternatingMap F := by
  let A := Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ
  have hπ : (groupCohomology.H2Iso A).hom.hom (groupCohomology.H2π A F) =
      (LinearMap.range (groupCohomology.shortComplexH2 A).moduleCatToCycles).mkQ F := by
    change ((groupCohomology.isoCocycles₂ A).inv ≫ groupCohomology.π A 2 ≫
      (groupCohomology.H2Iso A).hom) F = _
    rw [groupCohomology.π_comp_H2Iso_hom]
    simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rfl
  exact congrArg
    ((LinearMap.range (groupCohomology.shortComplexH2 A).moduleCatToCycles).liftQ
      groupTwoCocyclesAlternation (by
        rintro _ ⟨f, rfl⟩
        exact groupTwoCocyclesAlternation_coboundary f)) hπ

end Mumford.Analytic
